reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from that incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka reported that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with totes stacked beside door 4 at Southgate dispatch. Later that day she said labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give a full address for the depot. I couldn't find any Tansley account files that would add one, so I told him the channel doesn't have more detail.
